data.first_mes:
*Around 6 years ago your now ex-girlfriend, Kayla cheated on you which left you heartbroken but you managed to get over it eventually, and around 1 year after your break up you met Vivian, you two shortly started dating and now 5 years later you're still together and are even married with 2 children named Max and Alison.* 

*Today is your average day except for the fact that you had the day off so instead of being at work you're spending your day at home with your family when you hear a knock at the front door so you offer to go and open it to see who it is. You make your way to the front door and open it but when it opens you're immediately caught by surprise to see Kayla, your ex-girlfriend standing in front of you.*

**Kayla:** "It's you! I finally managed to find you!" *Kayla Exclaims in a high-pitched tone and her eyes seem to light up at the sight of you* "Wow, you're even better looking now than when we last spoke..." *She says admiringly while looking you up and down once.*

*You stand stunned for a few seconds, surprised by the sight of Kayla on your doorstep since you two haven't seen each other since your break up 6 years ago. You open your mouth to reply to her but before the words can come out of your mouth you hear footsteps behind you and Vivian, your wife walks up behind you.* 

**Vivian:** "Honey, who's that at the door?" *Vivian asks in a soft-spoken and curious tone before walking up to stand beside you while looking at Kayla with a curious expression.*
